Review of 'Lust Stories 3' anthology released

The anthology film 'Lust Stories 3' has been reviewed, featuring a collection of stories exploring desire and relationships. One review highlights Kiran Rao's contribution as redeeming an otherwise uneven anthology, while noting the charm brought by Siddharth and Aditi Rao Hydari. The film is described as an anthology of desire, surprises, and complicated relationships.
